title: 数字模块：SSI 绝对值编码器读取
summary: 驱动板现在用 MCU 的 SPI 软件读关节输出端的 SSI 编码器；把它做成芯片里的硬件模块：写 RTL，Icarus 逐拍仿真、和 Python 参考模型逐帧对照，扫线缆延迟找出能用多长的线，发现偶校验抓不住移位错，Yosys 综合看规模；按工程样片路线做一批。
summary_en: The drive board reads the joint-output SSI encoder with MCU SPI software; this case moves it into hardware on the chip: RTL, cycle-accurate Icarus simulation checked frame by frame against a Python reference model, a cable-delay sweep to find the usable length (even parity misses shifted frames), Yosys synthesis for size; one engineering-sample lot.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: SSI 17 位格雷码 + 偶校验；芯片 50 MHz、SSI 1 MHz；帧间 20 μs；≥ 1 kHz；线缆 2 m。
steps.summary_en: SSI, 17-bit Gray + even parity; 50 MHz core, 1 MHz SSI; 20 μs between frames; ≥ 1 kHz; 2 m cable.

tools.label: 电路板设计：B 版固件

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 三状态状态机 + 18 位移位寄存器；高电平最后一拍采样；两级同步；格雷码转换与偶校验。
steps.summary_en: Three-state FSM + 18-bit shift register; sample in the last cycle of the high phase; two-flop synchroniser; Gray conversion and even parity.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 一帧 38 μs（26.3 千帧/秒）；往返延迟预算 440 ns，约 38 m 线缆。
steps.summary_en: 38 μs per frame (26.3 k frames/s); 440 ns round-trip budget, about 38 m of cable.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 64 / 64 帧与参考模型一致；延迟 ≤ 450 ns 全对、500 ns 起出错；157 个错帧里 49 个校验没抓住。
steps.summary_en: 64 / 64 frames match the reference model; all correct up to 450 ns delay, errors from 500 ns; 49 of 157 bad frames slip past the parity check.

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: Yosys 综合：触发器 64、组合门 267；约为现有 WQ-ENCIF 逻辑的四分之一。
steps.summary_en: Yosys synthesis: 64 flip-flops, 267 gates; about a quarter of the present WQ-ENCIF logic.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 并进 RTL → LibreLane → 流片 → 晶圆测试 → 工程样片路线 12 道（含老化）→ 成品测试加 SSI 向量。
steps.summary_en: Merge RTL → LibreLane → tape-out → wafer probe → 12-step engineering-sample route (with burn-in) → SSI vectors at final test.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 工程样片一批（37 小时），成品测试不合格 0；本模块要等新一版流片后在样片上测。
steps.summary_en: One engineering-sample lot (37 h), 0 final-test failures; this block is tested on samples once the new revision is taped out.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 4 / 4 项校核通过；64 个触发器，延迟上限 450 ns。
steps.summary_en: 4 / 4 checks pass; 64 flip-flops, delay limit 450 ns.
